meta.name: model-usage
meta.description: Use CodexBar CLI local cost usage to summarize per-model usage for Codex or Claude, including the current (most recent) model or a full model breakdown. Trigger when asked for model-level usage/cost data from codexbar, or when you need a scriptable per-model summary from codexbar cost JSON.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按模型汇总 CodexBar 的用量与费用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 CodexBar 并需要按模型查看费用明细
copy.tagline_en: Summarize per-model usage and cost from CodexBar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use CodexBar and need per-model cost breakdown

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以读取 CodexBar 的本地费用日志，按模型（如 Codex 或 Claude）汇总使用费用，支持查看最近使用的模型或全部模型。
howto.when: 当你询问某个模型（如 Codex 或 Claude）的使用费用或成本明细时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下 Codex 最近使用的模型费用。
say.note: Claude 会运行脚本获取当前模型费用。

say.text: 列出 Claude 所有模型的费用明细。
say.note: Claude 会输出全部模型的费用汇总。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read CodexBar's local cost logs to summarize usage costs per model (e.g., Codex or Claude), supporting the most recent model or a full breakdown.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about model-level usage or cost data for Codex or Claude from CodexBar.

say_en.text: Show me the cost for the current Codex model.
say_en.note: Claude runs the script to get the current model cost.
Claude outputs a full cost breakdown.
